brief:
Israeli air strikes on Khan Younis in Gaza killed at least two Palestinians and wounded four others, Middle East Eye reported. The attack struck the southern city, a densely populated area that has faced repeated Israeli bombardment since the start of the conflict.

The toll reflects ongoing violence in the territory, where civilian casualties have mounted sharply in recent months.
dek: Israeli attacks kill at least five Palestinians in Gaza At least two Palestinians have been killed and four injured in Israeli air strikes on Khan Younis in Gaza.
title: Israeli strikes kill at least five Palestinians in Gaza
